article.title: The beginning of the end: Israel at the heart of the U.S.’s political civil war
article.author: Editor
article.content: Despite a seismic shift in the U.S. midterms, reflecting widespread rejection of pro-Israeli politicians, RAMZY BAROUD sees obstacles ahead in cutting the military umbilical cord that links the U.S. and Israeli military machines. The post The beginning of the end: Israel at the heart of the U.S.’s political civil war appeared first on MR Online .
